method.zh: 影片觀察、本人說法與遊戲設計推論分開標示。已逐格抽樣5支官方影片，涵蓋2018、2019、2021、2023、2026；未整場閱完，也未建立球種比例或3D動作擷取。跨期樣本可比較看得到的準備和還原結構，但對手、來球與鏡位不同，仍不足以量測整體打法變化。
method.en: Footage observations, testimony and game-design inferences are labeled separately. Five official videos from 2018, 2019, 2021, 2023 and 2026 have been sampled frame by frame, not watched in full or converted into shot-rate statistics or 3D motion capture. Cross-era samples illustrate visible preparation and recovery; differing opponents, balls and views prevent measurement of overall style changes.

summary.zh: 2019世界盃已抽樣五個不同比分回合：可見左手發球、台內前移接球、接完撤回，以及寬站距與正反手銜接。擰拉等技術名稱另由原始報導支持；這批影像未量測旋轉、成功率或全年打法。
summary.en: Five rallies at different scores were sampled from the 2019 World Cup. Visible features include left-handed service, moving into and out of table receives, a wide base and linked strokes. Flick terminology remains separately sourced from reports; this footage does not measure spin, success rates or the season’s style.

observation.zh: 2019 年技術報導：較高拋球配合兩次引拍，長短發球準備外形相近。
observation.en: The 2019 technical report describes a higher toss, two preparations and similar short/long service setups.

inference.zh: 發球動畫應保留拋球、引拍與揮拍的連續節奏。球速與長度要在最後接觸改變，單看起手不應提前揭露答案。
inference.en: Animate toss and preparation continuously; vary contact and length without revealing the outcome in the initial setup.

observation.en: In sampled games three, five, six and seven in 2019, Lin changes between short chest-front delivery and larger side swings. After finishing he faces the exchange again, with the free right arm adjusting alongside the racket arm.

inference.zh: 正、反手可共用準備狀態，出拍路徑與收拍要各自設計，銜接時讓胸肩和腳步重新定位。
inference.en: Strokes can share readiness, but delivery and finish need distinct paths with chest, shoulders and feet repositioning between shots.

observation.en: At 8–7 in game four, Lin moves into the far table corner at 499.4–500.2 seconds, then retreats and widens the feet at 500.2–501.2. Game six also shows larger lateral steps followed by renewed readiness; position responds to the next ball.

inference.zh: 台內接球要包含前移、支撐、撤回三段；回合中的還原位置由下一板決定。
inference.en: A table receive needs move-in, support and retreat stages. Recovery position follows the next ball.

summary.en: Two live rallies and one slow replay were sampled from Frankfurt 2023. Post-service retreat, flexed readiness and lateral adjustments are traceable; the replay shows a larger left-handed forehand finish with free-arm coordination. Receive distributions and speed changes from 2019 remain unmeasured.

observation.zh: 35–45與138–144秒都可见林以右手拋球、左手揮拍，發球後撤出靠台姿態、屈膝展開雙腳，繼續準備回球。
observation.en: At both 35–45 and 138–144 seconds, Lin tosses with the right hand, swings with the left and retreats from service into flexed, wider readiness for the return.

inference.zh: 左手發球需要把拋球手、站位、收拍和撤步一起處理。
inference.en: Left-handed service requires coordinated tossing hand, stance, finish and retreat.

observation.zh: 2023 年本人說法蘭克福增加擺短、速推。對手等擰拉或球太外側時改接法。
observation.en: In 2023 he described adding stops and fast pushes when opponents anticipated a flick or served too wide.

inference.zh: 可依來球位置與對手站位切換接法，保留相近的靠近來球動作。
inference.en: Switch receives with ball and opponent position while retaining similar approach movements.

Harimoto already links exchanges through flexion, forward lean, lateral adjustments, short chest-front delivery and recovery, including whole-body reset after service. inference.en: The early-era service animation also needs post-service footwork and recovery.

title.zh: 2018、2021、2026：緊湊回擊仍有全身還原
title.en: 2018, 2021 and 2026: compact strokes include whole-body recovery

observation.zh: 2018胸前回擊伴隨展步和收回；2021短反手也有降低胸口、彎肘和自由手配合；2026近景可見短出拍後重新準備，寬景則可補看腳步。
observation.en: The 2018 chest-front return includes a widening step and withdrawal. The 2021 short backhand coordinates a lowered chest, bent elbow and free arm. The 2026 close replay shows renewed readiness after short delivery, supplemented by wide-view footwork.

inference.zh: 三個年份都要呈現完整銜接。2026也可見較大正手，但不同來球與鏡位的樣本不能證明近年反手依賴減少、正手更強或失誤變少；這些仍需匹配回合和全場標註。
inference.en: All three eras need linked motion. A larger forehand is also visible in 2026, but differing balls and camera views do not establish less backhand dependence, greater forehand power or fewer errors. Those claims need matched rallies and whole-match annotation.

observation.zh: 同一 Doha 重播中，林的左手與張本的右手姿勢方向不同，兩人都有屈膝前傾、寬站距與隨回合橫向調整。
observation.en: In the same Doha replay, Lin’s left-handed and Harimoto’s right-handed arrangements differ, while both show flexion, forward lean, a wide base and lateral adjustment.

inference.zh: 動畫可共用到位與還原的基本結構，持拍側及個人接法另處理。
inference.en: Animation can share positioning and recovery principles while handling handedness and receives separately.

limits.zh: 同一回合不能比較整體風格、力量或兩人各球種使用率。
limits.en: One rally cannot establish overall style, power or shot distributions.

globalLimits.zh: 轉播視角、對手球路、比分與球桌遮擋會混雜動作比較；不從2D影像推算精確3D關節角、旋轉或比例。
globalLimits.en: Camera, opponent, score and table occlusion confound comparisons; no exact 3D angles, spin or rates are inferred.

globalLimits.zh: 五支影片、18段抽樣序列支持具體姿態和銜接例子，未整場閱完。含慢動作、精華與部分遮擋，也不是無偏的跨期比較；本人訪談與原始報導保留獨立來源標示。
globalLimits.en: Five videos and 18 sampled sequences support specific posture and transition examples, not full-match viewing. Replay, highlights and occlusion prevent an unbiased era comparison; testimony and original reports retain separate labels.
